name: bcion-lite-styles
description: Tailwind build for BCION Lite's server-rendered templates (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: 'Server-rendered templates ... served by the same app -- No separate front-end framework'). Node/npm is a DEV-TIME build tool only, same tier as ruff/mypy -- the compiled output (app/static/css/app.css) is checked in and served as a plain static file; nothing at runtime or in production requires Node.
